Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sector

Class Sector

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.observer.AbstractObservable
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sector.Sector
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observable, Observer, Serializable
public class Sector extends AbstractObservable implements Observer
A sector groups several consecutive seat rows under a single display panel.

It is the heart of the centralised system: it observes its RowSensors and, whenever one of them changes, it recomputes how many of its spectators are currently out of their seats. A full but seated audience is calm, so the alert is driven by movement, not by seat occupancy: when too many spectators are up and moving in the aisles at once (the real congestion signal) it puts its DisplayPanel into PanelMode.ALERT and fires a SECTOR_CONGESTION_ALERT event for the supervisor; when it clears, the panel returns to standby. A manual panic scenario can also raise the alert directly.

Monitoring can be switched off (see setMonitoring(boolean)) so that an ongoing evacuation message is not overwritten by congestion handling.

Version:
1.0

GROUPE E

  • Field Details

    • DEFAULT_CONGESTION_THRESHOLD

      public static final double DEFAULT_CONGESTION_THRESHOLD
      Default movement ratio (0..1) above which the sector raises an alert, i.e. the fraction of the sector's spectators that must be out of their seats at once to count as real congestion. A calm, fully seated audience has a movement ratio of 0, so it never triggers a false alarm.

    • Sector

      public Sector(String sectorId, List<RowSensor> rowSensors, DisplayPanel panel, Node centreNode)
      Builds a sector and subscribes it to every one of its row sensors.
      Parameters:
      sectorId - unique identifier (e.g. "SEC_1"); never null
      rowSensors - the consecutive row sensors covered by this sector
      panel - the display panel of the sector
      centreNode - the graph node at the centre of the sector (used for the panel anchor and direction computation)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if sectorId is null

    • refresh

      public void refresh()
      Recomputes the sector's crowd movement and updates the panel accordingly: escalates to PanelMode.ALERT when too many spectators are out of their seats at once (real congestion), de-escalates to standby when it clears. Safe to call at any time (e.g. right after building the sector).

    • computeMovementRatio

      public double computeMovementRatio()
      Fraction of the sector's spectators currently away from their seat (up and moving in the aisles). Near 0 for a calm, seated audience; it rises only when many people move at once, which is the real congestion signal.
      Returns:
      a value in [0, 1] (0 if the sector has no seat)
